item.name: Power Train Harmony Rail Train Set High Speed Railway Stations Simulated Carriage Bullet Train Set
item.title: Power Train Harmony Rail Train Set High Speed Railway Stations Simulated Carriage Bullet Train Set
item.description:
• Battery: 2 x AAA
• Realistic high-speed bullet train with soft lighting
• Adjustable speed for dynamic play
• Multiple carriage links – connect in any order
• Easy setup – snap-fit tracks & accessories
• Comes with trees, signs, lights & more
• Available in 17pcs, 31pcs, 86pcs and red intermediate set
• Made from child-safe, non-toxic ABS material
• Recommended for age 3+
• Option: Starter 2185-17PCS / Beginner 2184-31PCS / Intermediate-20818-Red/ Advanced 2181-86PCS

Bina dunia kereta api impian anda dengan PowerTrain Set Kereta Api Laju.
Diperbuat daripada bahan ABS berkualiti dan selamat untuk kanak-kanak, kereta api ini dilengkapi lampu lembut, kelajuan boleh laras, dan pelbagai aksesori bandar seperti pokok, papan tanda, dan stesen.
Hanya masukkan 2 bateri AAA (tidak disertakan) dan nikmati perjalanan kereta api yang menyeronokkan.
Pilihan set dari Permulaan hingga Lanjutan – sesuai untuk kanak-kanak dan peminat kereta api.

Build your dream railway world with this PowerTrain High-Speed Rail Set.
Made from safe, high-quality ABS, this electric bullet train features adjustable speed, realistic soft lighting, and multiple city-themed accessories like trees, road signs, and station platforms.
Just insert 2 AAA batteries (not included) and watch the train travel the track smoothly.
Choose from Starter, Beginner, Intermediate, or Advanced sets – perfect for kids and train lovers alike.
